name: banjo
description: Jewelbox 54 Banjo: a walnut wall-hanger rail with a brass yoke is the striker; the whole banjo hangs upright from it by the headstock - pearl-button tuners, maple neck with ebony fingerboard, chrome frets and pearl dots, 5th-string peg, and the round pot at the bottom with white head, chrome hoop and brackets, bridge, tailpiece and five strings.
